name: tug-of-war
title: Tug of War
description: Diverging duel bars: two contenders split a 100% rope per row; the brighter side is the winner.

meta.question: Who wins where, head to head?
meta.whenToUse: Head-to-head comparison of exactly two entities across several arenas (benchmarks, markets, categories) where per-row winner and margin matter.
meta.antiUse: Not for 3+ contenders, absolute magnitudes, or trends over time — the rope only shows the relative split per row.
